author: end-to-end-soundness
body_markdown: The constant-factor bound in `E2E-21` relies essentially on $D=O_\theta(d)$. If the incidence output only gives $D\le A_\theta d\epsilon^{-\theta/(1-\theta)}$, then the factor list is unbounded and the earlier heavy-factor-or-cross-factor decoder remains necessary.
subject: Do not weaken the bounded-weight interface
